
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhuweisky/p/19553527" title="发布于 2026-01-30 14:52">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">实现鸿蒙（HarmonyOS）视频聊天、屏幕分享</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        随着搭配原生鸿蒙（HarmonyOS）系统的电脑和手机越来越普及，之前实现的Windows和安卓版的视频聊天屏幕分享Demo，现在有必要实现一个鸿蒙版了！
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>　随着搭配原生鸿蒙（HarmonyOS）系统的电脑和手机越来越普及，之前实现的<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhuweisky/p/17579589.html" target="_blank">安卓版视频聊天屏幕分享的Demo</a>，现在有必要实现一个鸿蒙版了，该鸿蒙版的Demo可以与之前的安卓版和PC版互通的。&nbsp;</p>
<p>　现在，我们来看看具体的实现过程，文末有Demo源码可以下载。</p>
<h2>一. 开发环境</h2>
<p>开发工具：DevEco Studio 6.0</p>
<p>开发语言：ArkTS</p>
<p>测试手机：华为 Mate 60 Pro&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>HarmonyOS：6.0.0</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/9005/202601/9005-20260130143205582-1489185788.jpg" alt="screenshot_20260130_142928" width="240" height="518" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>二．<strong>功能介绍</strong></h2>
<p class="p">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 鸿蒙手机端登录成功后，运行的主界面如下图所示：&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202601/20404-20260120145037184-1457081903.jpg" alt="IMG_1768891881_009" width="234" height="505" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3>1. 视频聊天</h3>
<p class="p">（1）每个登录的用户都可向其他任意在线用户发送视频聊天请求。</p>
<p class="p">（2）当收到来自其他在线用户的视频聊天邀请时，可接受或拒绝对方的请求。</p>
<p class="p">（3）当接受其他在线用户的视频聊天邀请时，即可开启视频聊天。&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="p">2. 屏幕分享</h3>
<p class="p">（1）每个登录的用户都可向其他任意在线用户发送屏幕分享请求；当对方未响应时，可主动取消屏幕分享请求。</p>
<p class="p">（2）当收到来自其他在线用户请求屏幕分享时，可接受或拒绝对方的请求。</p>
<p class="p">（3）当发送方收到其他在线用户同意屏幕分享时，即可观看对方的屏幕。</p>
<h2>三．<strong>具体实现</strong></h2>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 下面我们讲一下Demo中核心的代码实现，</p>
<h3><strong>1.自定义消息类型 InformationTypes</strong></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>export <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">enum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType{

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 视频请求
 * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

  VideoRequest </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   *  对方同意连接摄像头
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  VideoResult </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   *  通知对方 挂断 视频连接
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  CloseVideo </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   *  通知好友 网络原因，导致 视频中断
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
   NetReasonCloseVideo </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   * 通知对方(忙线中) 挂断 视频连接
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  BusyLine </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   * 远程桌面请求
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  DesktopRequest </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   *  回复远程桌面请求的结果
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  DesktopResult </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   * 主动取消远程桌面请求
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  CancelDesktop </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   * 对方（主人端）主动断开远程桌面
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  OwnerCloseDesktop </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
   * 客人端断开远程桌面连接
   * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  GuestCloseDesktop </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">9</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>2. 发送视频请求</h3>
<p>（1）当发起视频聊天时，将显示视频聊天窗口,并发送视频连接请求</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">获取到多媒体管理器</span>
@State multimediaManager: IMultimediaManager =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MultimediaManagerFactory.GetSingleton();
Button(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请求视频会话</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).type(ButtonType.Normal).borderRadius(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>).backgroundColor(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">#DBDCDE</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).fontColor(Color.Black).fontWeight(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">300</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
.onClick(()</span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.pathStack) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">发送视频连接请求 </span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.multimediaManager.sendCustomizedMessage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.connectID,informationType.VideoRequest,[],<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">跳转到视频请求页面</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.pathStack.pushPath({ name:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">video</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> ,param:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.connectID})
})</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;（2）连接自己的摄像头，预览自己的视频</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">只需要在模板层调用这个组件，就会连接到自己的摄像头</span>
CameraPreview()</pre>
</div>
<p>（3）当发送聊天邀请时，将显示视频邀请窗口&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202601/20404-20260120145906525-807654024.jpg" alt="IMG_1768892392_012" width="234" height="505" loading="lazy">&nbsp;</p>
<h3>3. 回复对方视频请求</h3>
<p>（1）当收到对方的视频聊天邀请时，将显示视频邀请窗口&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202601/20404-20260120150023513-1437224293.jpg" alt="IMG_1768892490_013" width="234" height="505" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;（2）发送回复视频聊天请求消息</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">同意对方的视频邀请
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">connectID - 对方的ID</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.multimediaManager.sendCustomizedMessage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.connectID,informationType.VideoResult,[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>],<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">拒绝对方的视频邀请</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.multimediaManager.sendCustomizedMessage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.connectID,informationType.CloseVideo,[],<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h3>4. 收到对方视频请求的回复</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置收到来自服务器或其它客户端的自定义消息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.multimediaManager.setCustomizedMessageListener((srcUserID: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, msgType: number, msg: number[], tag: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>)=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">对方回复视频请求的结果</span>
                          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(msgType ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> informationType.VideoResult){
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> res = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Stream(msg)
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> res.readBoolean()
                            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">){
                             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">当对方回复同意时，将连接到对方的麦克风和摄像头，开始视频聊天会话</span>
                              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.isAnswer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                            }</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                             </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">否则直接挂断</span>
                              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.promptAction.showToast({
                                message: `对方挂断`,
                                duration: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                              })
                              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.isAnswer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.isOnVideo = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.connect2me = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.pageStack.removeByName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">video</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                            }
                          }

})    </span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;当对方回复同意时，将连接到对方的麦克风和摄像头，开始视频聊天会话：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.isAnswer){
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.cameraConnector = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CameraConnector()
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.microphoneConnector = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MicrophoneConnector()
      
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置摄像头的索引</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.multimediaManager.setCameraDeviceIndex(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.switchCamera?<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">开始连接对方摄像头</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.cameraConnector.beginConnect(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.connectID)
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">开始连接对方麦克风</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.microphoneConnector.beginConnect(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.connectID)
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">启动定时器计时</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.timer()
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>5. 实现屏幕分享</h3>
<p class="p">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;屏幕分享的请求/应答逻辑几乎与视频聊天请求/应答逻辑是一模一样的。这里就不再罗列响应的代码了。</p>
<p class="p">　　&nbsp; 下面的截图是以Windows与鸿蒙互动为例：Windows端作为请求方，鸿蒙端作为应答方。（反过来也是一样的）</p>
<p class="p">（1）PC端发起请求&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/9005/202601/9005-20260130145738014-1390202129.png" alt="1234" width="377" height="123" loading="lazy"></p>
<p class="p">（2）鸿蒙端收到对方的屏幕分享请求时，将显示请求窗口。</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202601/20404-20260120142332871-1956298305.jpg" alt="IMG_1768890229_008" width="234" height="505" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;（3）当鸿蒙端同意请求时，PC端就可以观看鸿蒙手机的屏幕了。</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202601/20404-20260120144027779-1099460013.png" alt="QQ_1768891224958" width="570" height="321" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2>&nbsp;四. 源码下载</h2>
<p>&nbsp;1. 鸿蒙端源码：<strong>&nbsp;<span class="style1"><a href="https://dl.oraycn.com/DownLoadFiles/OMCS/VideoChatMini_HarmonyOS.rar" rel="noopener nofollow">VideoChatMini_HarmonyOS.rar</a>&nbsp;</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;2.&nbsp;Android 端：<strong><a href="https://dl.oraycn.com/DownLoadFiles/OMCS/VideoChatMini.Android.rar" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">VideoChatMini.Android.rar</a></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;3. 服务端 + PC 端：<strong><a href="https://dl.oraycn.com/DownLoadFiles/OMCS/VideoChatMini.rar" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">VideoChatMini.rar</a></strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>在这里，我也给出了PC端的源码，PC端项目对应的目录是 VideoChatMini.ClientWPF。服务端和PC端都是 C# 开发的（开发环境是 VS2022），PC端UI使用的是WPF。</p>
<p>鸿蒙端、PC端、安卓端是可以互通的，也就是可以相互视频通话，以及观看屏幕/桌面。</p>
<p>在实现了该Demo的鸿蒙手机版后，接下来，我还会实现该Demo的鸿蒙PC版，到时再分享给大家！</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
